blocks.name: selected_agents
blocks.description: Which agents were selected for each slot, and why.

source.response_field: ranked agent list with scores, node_id, input_schema_id, output_schema_id

blocks.why: Derived from the select_agent ranked output — the scores are computed by the platform from calibration history, cost, fidelity, and valence. The selection decision itself is the strategist's: it picks from the top of the ranked list and may override for unusual queries.

blocks.name: steps

source.response_field: execution envelope per delegation hop: agent, gate_input, gate_output, duration_ms, failure

blocks.why: Each step records which agent ran, what input schema was validated, what output schema was produced, and whether the gate approved. Derived from the envelope at each delegation hop — not inferred by the strategist.

blocks.name: synthesis

source.from: steps outputs + declared synthesis protocol on the coordination graph

blocks.why: The synthesis protocol (selection/aggregation/cep_weighted) is declared on the coordination graph; the strategist applies it to the step outputs. This is a judgement over the collected evidence, not a retrieval.
